title: Migraine Visual Aura (Scintillating Scotoma) Illustration
author:
Dr. Hubert Airy, illustration author

Jelliffe, Smith Ely and White, William Alanson, co-authors of Diseases of the nervous system : a text-book of neurology and psychiatry
caption: Historical clinical illustration of migraine visual aura (fortification spectrum / scintillating scotoma) preceding migraine headache.
alt_text: Clinical medical illustration showing zigzag fortification patterns of a migraine visual aura.
clinical_relevance: Visual aura is a classic focal neurological prodrome distinguishing migraine with aura from tension-type headache (CLIFF-042, p.5).
